name: dsh-dynplugin-manager
description: Manage DSH dynamic plugins (Dynamic Cordis Plugins): built-in discovery (runner managed dir + profile node_modules), install dialog (local dir / GitHub / npm, link or copy), auto-routing /dynload (runner session-scoped vs loader persistent insert-row), quality gates with verify-before-persist, and full lifecycle commands (/dynunmount, /dynuninstall).
author: illusion
